abstract: Maintains hazardous materials containment verifications and toxic chemical runoff control permits
system_message:
You are Environmental protection officer (ENV). The Environmental Protection Officer (ENV) oversees hazardous materials containment verifications, toxic chemical runoff control permits, and environmental soil permeability profiling across candidate aerial suppression staging airbases.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Soil permeability profiling（SOIL）
information_points.content:
ENV-SOIL-VUO：At the Cascade Foothills Tanker Staging Hub, the buffer zone soil hydraulic conductivity across the containment ditch unlined buffer strip is measured at 25 mm/h.
ENV-SOIL-JQ6：At the Mendocino Ridge Interagency Base, the buffer zone soil hydraulic conductivity across the containment ditch unlined buffer strip is measured at 15 mm/h.
ENV-SOIL-EX9：At the Silverstone Valley Air Attack Base, the buffer zone soil hydraulic conductivity across the containment ditch unlined buffer strip is measured at 40 mm/h.

information_points.title: Maintains hazardous materials containment verifications and toxic chemical runoff control permits（CONTAIN）
information_points.content:
ENV-CONTAIN-7D2：For the Silverstone Valley Air Attack Base, the retardant runoff containment certification is confirmed following environmental inspection of sealed secondary retention capacity and spill barrier isolation for base chemical retardant storage and loading apron drainage.
ENV-CONTAIN-C9N：For the Cascade Foothills Tanker Staging Hub, the retardant runoff containment certification is not held, as formal validation of sealed secondary retention capacity and spill barrier isolation across base chemical retardant storage and loading apron drainage was not achieved.
ENV-CONTAIN-PDA：For the Mendocino Ridge Interagency Base, the retardant runoff containment certification is confirmed based on formal validation of sealed secondary retention capacity and spill barrier isolation across base chemical retardant storage and loading apron drainage.
